cases.notes: One dot publishes a belief; nine dots read it and republish it five times each. Echoes must not raise confidence. The dashed line is what naive revision would have done.

cases.name: Independent corroboration
cases.notes: Nine dots observe the same thing without reading each other. Independent evidence should raise confidence, exactly as NAL predicts: the guard against echoes must not block real corroboration.

cases.name: Self-repetition
cases.notes: One dot says the same thing 50 times. Confidence must stay where it started.

cases.name: Retry storm
cases.notes: A dot stuck in a loop fires 200 model calls as fast as it can. The calls-per-minute ceiling (60) must cut it off.

cases.name: Spend runaway
cases.notes: A dot on a paid model ($3/$15 per M tokens) with a $0.25 budget keeps calling. Spend must never pass the budget: each call's worst case is reserved before it is made.

cases.name: Abandoned goal recovery
cases.notes: posted: open; claimed by dot 1: claimed; dot 1 went silent: open; claimed by dot 2: claimed; dot 2 waits on a person: waiting; lease check while waiting: waiting; reply arrived: claimed; dot 2 finished: done

series.name: goal state (0 open, 1 claimed, 2 waiting, 4 done)

cases.name: Subgoal explosion
cases.notes: A dot tries to split one goal into 100 subgoals and nest them 10 deep. Splitting must stop at 12 wide and 3 deep.

cases.name: Paid model without a budget
cases.notes: Refusals that must happen before any money moves: no budget, no price.

cases.name: Subject symmetry
cases.notes: Eight pairs of opposed subjects receive identical evidence from identical sources. Every pair must end with exactly the same truth value: the evidence threshold cannot depend on who a claim is about.

cases.name: Source identity
cases.notes: The same evidence published by dots with different names, personas and colours must count the same. Only evidence and its independence may matter, not who the source looks like.

series.name: confidence by persona
series.x: a cautious archivist / a bold activist / an anonymous account / a senior official

cases.name: Order independence
cases.notes: Four independent reports arrive in all 24 orders. The commons must reach the same belief every time, so whoever speaks first gets no advantage.

cases.name: Gate consistency
cases.notes: The policy gate must give every dot the same decision for the same command, unless a rule names that dot or its swarm.

cases.name: Model paired-prompt symmetry
cases.message: needs a real model: set HIVE_BENCH_MODEL and its API key
cases.notes: Paired prompts that differ only in who the claim is about must get matching verdicts from the model. This needs a real model: set HIVE_BENCH_MODEL (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5) and its key.

cases.name: Resources at idle
cases.notes: Three dots connected and waiting. Memory is resident set size summed over each dot's processes (PeTTa plus its channel daemon).

cases.name: Resources under load
cases.notes: 15 messages, three at a time, across three dots.

cases.name: Reply latency under load
cases.notes: Includes the Omega loop's sleep between cycles (3 s), which dominates.

cases.name: Energy per reply
cases.notes: Estimated: no power meter is readable here, so energy is CPU time × 12 W per busy core (HIVE_BENCH_WATTS_PER_CORE). Excludes the model: the mock model costs nothing to run.

cases.name: Cost per reply (projected)
cases.notes: The run used the free mock model; these apply its measured tokens to each priced model. A real model writes longer replies, so treat these as a floor.

cases.name: Efficiency
cases.notes: Prompt size per call shows context growth: a steady climb means the context keeps accumulating and will rot.

cases.name: Task accuracy
cases.notes: Mock model: this checks that instructions reach the commons exactly and come back on request. Reasoning accuracy needs a real model (set HIVE_BENCH_MODEL).

cases.name: Dot crash recovery
cases.notes: Killed all 3 processes of one dot with SIGKILL, then sent it a message while it was down.

cases.name: Model outage survival
cases.notes: Pointed one dot at a model server that is not there for 12 s, then back.

cases.name: Hive restart
cases.notes: Stopped and restarted the hive server with 5 beliefs in the commons.

cases.name: Message burst after restart
cases.notes: Twelve messages right after the restart.

cases.notes: Each step's commons belief read as a probability (NAL expectation) and scored against the warranted verdict. 0 is perfect; 0.25 is a coin flip. Steps whose warranted verdict is quarantine or provisional are left out.
